result:
I moved the "Team Created" success notification out of the component and into the `useCreateTeam` mutation hook, as the review asked. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, per your instruction.

- **`features/teams/api/create-team.ts`:** `useCreateTeam` now calls `useNotifications` and adds the success notification at the start of its `onSuccess`. It still invalidates the teams query and then calls any caller-supplied `onSuccess`.
- **`features/teams/components/create-team.tsx`:** I removed the `useNotifications` import and call. The component now just calls `useCreateTeam()`.

A search of `src` found no other uncommitted new code that uses `useNotifications` outside an `api/` hook. The existing discussion, comment and user components still call `useNotifications` themselves. I left them alone because the feedback covered only the new change.
